name: Oren Farhi
title: Principal Frontend Engineer — AI Product Engineer & UI Architect
summary:
Principal-level frontend engineer and UI architect with 20+ years of experience turning complex product requirements into scalable, maintainable software. Expert in TypeScript, React and end-to-end quality, with hands-on implementation, testing infrastructure and technical leadership.
Most effective in ambiguous environments: I make pragmatic architectural decisions, write the hard parts, raise engineering standards and mentor engineers. I use AI-assisted development as a force multiplier while keeping architecture, correctness and security human-led.
Author of Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX (Springer) and creator of ngx-infinite-scroll (1.3M+ monthly npm downloads).
